messages:
teagan: Quick design pass on Compliance settings — three small but high-impact nits: (1) region selector keyboard flow jumps when tabbing from Retention, (2) the key pill language is ambiguous and spawns support tickets, (3) audit/export timestamps are confusing for auditors. Can we do a short sync?

marco: Repro for (1): open Project > Compliance, tab to Retention dropdown, then Tab to Region. The region menu briefly opens then collapses. Happens in Chrome/Firefox. Feels like the list loses focus before it receives it.

leigh: Classic blur race. Short fix: keep the options container immediately after the trigger in DOM order, set role="listbox" on the options, keep aria-expanded="true" on the trigger until the list actually receives focus, and only close on Escape or outside click. Also manage aria-activedescendant so screen readers announce the focused item.

teagan: Nice. For keyboard flow, if the list is already open and the user Tabs into the trigger, we should programmatically focus the first option so Tab lands inside the list rather than collapsing it.

marco: Will prototype that. I'll add a tiny unit test that simulates Tab from Retention -> Region and asserts the first option has document.activeElement.

leigh: Copy/thread for (2): support keeps getting "do you hold my key?" when pill reads "Managed key — Redwood". I prefer avoiding the verb "manage" alone. Suggestions I mocked: 
- "Key custody: Redwood"
- "Key custody: Customer (BYOK)"
- fallback single-line: "Custody: Redwood / Customer (BYOK)"
Small explainer accessible via aria-describedby should read: "Who can rotate or revoke the master key."

support-bot: From support: customers want a canonical one-liner for canned replies. Proposed canonical: "Key custody — Redwood-managed / Customer-managed (BYOK). BYOK means you provide the key material; Redwood does not have access to that key material." Please include that in the PR description. Also request a data attribute data-key-custody="redwood|customer" on the settings row for triage. Keep telemetry retention to 90 days and do not include any key identifiers.

teagan: Agreed. Also we should include a help icon that opens a short modal (<=120 words) explaining implications (rotate, revoke, who can request access) plus a link to docs. Modal must be keyboard and screen-reader friendly.

leigh: Visual a11y nit: current pill hover contrast for 12px text measures ~3.7:1. Need >=4.5:1 for small text. Options: bump font-weight to 600, darken background by ~8%, or use 13px system font for pills. I prefer weight + slight darken to keep density. Also ensure focus ring is visible (3px) and meets contrast requirements.

marco: I'll adjust styles and include before/after swatches with WCAG numbers in the PR.

teagan: For (3) export timestamps: console currently shows local time but CSV exports UTC which breaks audits. Security favors unambiguous exports. Proposal: always export ISO-8601 with timezone offset, e.g., "2026-03-23T14:23:00-07:00". In the UI show header "Timestamp (your timezone)" and a tooltip that lists the exact offset and an option to "Show UTC". In export dialog show a short note: "CSV uses ISO-8601 with timezone offset for auditability."

leigh: Agree. Also add an e2e test that parses exported CSV and asserts timestamps include an offset.

support-bot: Small additional ask: when customer's timezone differs from project timezone, show a subtle banner in the audit view: "Showing timestamps in your timezone (PDT, UTC-7). Exported CSV includes offset." That reduces first-contact confusion.

marco: Mobile/UI nit: on narrow widths the help icon gets hidden behind the pill. For <420px, hide the icon and show a compact "Learn more" link beneath the setting. Link should have aria-controls to open the modal.

leigh: Accessibility checklist: add aria-describedby on pill for hidden explainer, role=listbox + aria-activedescendant for region options, keyboard test covering Tab sequence and Escape-to-close, and VoiceOver smoke test notes in the component README.

teagan: Plan: marco will PR DOM reorder + role/listbox + focus-into-first-option + style adjustments for contrast + data-key-custody attribute. leigh will draft modal copy and hidden explainer text + add VoiceOver notes. Support-bot will add canonical canned reply and telemetry retention guidance. Aim for PR by Friday EOD.

marco: I'll include screenshots, contrast numbers, and a small keyboard-nav test. Will call out the exact telemetry enum and retention policy in the PR.

support-bot: Confirmed: data-key-custody enum accepted; retention = 90 days. Do not log key ids or key material.

teagan: Thanks folks. Please tag me in the PR for quick review. Closing thread after merges. :white_check_mark:
